entries.voice.lesson.start: Keep left, scan ahead, and drive smoothly.
entries.voice.lesson.passed: Well done, you passed this lesson cleanly.
entries.voice.lesson.try_again: Let us review what happened and try again.
entries.voice.GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.fault: Check your blind spot and signal before changing lanes.
entries.voice.GB.OBS.LANE_CHANGE.good: Nice smooth lane change with a clear gap.
entries.voice.GB.SIG.TIMELY.fault: Signal earlier so other drivers have time to react.
entries.voice.GB.SPD.OVER_LIMIT.fault: Ease off the speed, you are over the limit.
entries.voice.GB.GAP.TWO_SECOND.fault: Drop back a little, leave at least two seconds.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.fault: Give way to traffic coming from your right.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.GIVE_WAY_RIGHT.good: Good roundabout priority check to the right.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.fault: Pick the lane matching your exit before the roundabout.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.APPROACH_LANE.good: Good early lane choice on the approach.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.SIGNAL_APPROACH.fault: Match your approach signal to your roundabout exit.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.SIGNAL_EXIT.fault: Signal left after passing the exit before yours.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.fault: Hold your marked lane around the roundabout.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.STAY_IN_LANE.good: Smooth lane discipline around the island.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.fault: Always go clockwise around UK roundabouts.
entries.voice.GB.RBT.WRONG_WAY.good: Clean clockwise path around the roundabout.
entries.voice.GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.fault: Give cyclists at least 1.5 metres when passing.
entries.voice.GB.VRU.PASS_CYCLIST.good: Great wide clearance past the cyclist.
